name: Corteco USA
old_description: Welcome to Corteco, your premier spare parts supplier in the Independent Aftermarket. As a proud member of the global Freudenberg Group, we specialize in delivering components essential for optimal vehicle and machinery performance. With a comprehensive range of over 26,000 products, including sealing solutions, vibration control with rubber-metal parts, and premium cabin air filtration, we ensure OEM quality that exceeds industry standards.
about:
Corteco USA operates from Milan, Ohio, as the North American aftermarket arm of the Freudenberg Group, a global technology company. The business supplies spare parts to independent repair garages and distributors, leveraging the Freudenberg portfolio of original-equipment components.

The company offers a catalog of more than 26,000 products across four main categories: sealing solutions such as oil seals and gaskets (including the Simmerring® brand), rubber-to-metal components for vibration control, steering and suspension parts numbering over 7,000 references, and cabin air filtration with roughly 850 filter variations. The sealing line includes the iconic Simmerring® radial shaft seal, while the rubber-to-metal range covers engine mounts, suspension bushings, and driveline dampers. The steering and suspension assortment encompasses bushings, ball joints, tie rods, and complete kits. Filtration focuses on cabin air filters with activated carbon and particulate media. Customers access the range through an online catalog (ecatcorteco.com) and a dedicated seal-finder tool (findyourseal.com).

Corteco serves the independent automotive aftermarket, targeting passenger cars, heavy-duty trucks, two-wheelers, and emerging e-mobility platforms. Its parts are sold to independent garages and wholesale distributors worldwide.

The brand positions itself on OE-quality standards, emphasizing that its Corteco and TransTec labels deliver original-equipment performance backed by Freudenberg engineering.
